tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Score a text 0-100 for signs of AI/machine writing, with the band (low/moderate/elevated/high) and plain-English reasons. Set deep=true for the most thorough read (slower, quota-limited). If the text is in a language the scanner cannot read yet, it gets no score and the answer says why. Signal, not

tools.name: cleanup_text
tools.description: Strip machine typography from text without rewriting a word: smart quotes, em dashes and the rare glyphs AI models overuse become plain keyboard characters. Returns the cleaned text.
